findings.claim: 2008Q4（上一輪衰退起點）EBIT 率由 9.2% 降到 3.9%（排除重整費用 5.0%）；公司 2009 年初指引銷售降約 20%、EBIT 率 6.5%
findings.excerpt: EBIT decreased to $129 million, or 3.9 percent of sales, from $324 million, or 9.2 percent of sales a year ago. Excluding the restructuring charge, EBIT was $166 million, or 5.0 percent of sales.

findings.claim: 2020Q1 營收年減 17%，合併 EBITDA 率 16.9%（去年同期 17.2%），顯示 2019-20 下行初期利潤率僅小幅下滑
findings.source: Cummins Revenue Drops 17 Percent in First Quarter (RER Magazine)
findings.excerpt: consolidated EBITDA was 16.9 percent of sales, compared to 17.2 percent a year ago

findings.claim: 2019 年 Class 8 產量九個月內下降 55%，高階主管稱 18 年來未見；ACT 稱高峰通常持續約 13-15 個月
